def catmull_rom(knots, steps_per_segment=12):
    a=np.asarray(knots,dtype=np.float64)
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(a)-1):

    out.append(a[-1])
    return np.asarray(out)

    ds=np.hypot(np.diff(dense[:,0]),np.diff(dense[:,1]))*px_m
    arc=np.r_[0.0,np.cumsum(ds)]
    count=max(2,int(math.ceil(arc[-1]/spacing_m))+1)
